sections.title: What differs and must be verified

sentences.text: Verify the counterexample GNAO1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements): clinical similarity P=0.98, mechanism M=0.00; it is excluded by the mechanism layer.
Verify CACNA1A-related disease (migraine, familial hemiplegic, 1): 1 shared process term(s) (Regulation of insulin secretion; R-HSA-422356); M=0.11, S=0.50, excluded by M layer.
Verify SLC2A1-related disease (hereditary cryohydrocytosis with reduced stomatin): 1 shared process term(s) (Regulation of insulin secretion; R-HSA-422356); M=0.08, S=0.49, excluded by M layer.

Verify GRIN1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with or without hyperkinetic movements and seizures, autosomal dominant): 1 shared process term(s) (Neurexins and neuroligins; R-HSA-6794361); M=0.06, S=0.55, excluded by M layer.

Coverage of STX1B-related disease (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 9) phenotype information is 55% (5 of 8 terms; IC 16.98/30.76) using Natural History Study in Pediatric Patients with STXBP1 Encephalopathy with Epilepsy.
Verify STXBP1 membership in Neurotransmitter release cycle (stability 1.00).
Verify STX1B-related disease (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 9): shared mechanism evidence is physical/curated interaction (STRING exp/db 0.96) (S 0.92).

Verify VAMP2-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and autistic features with or without hyperkinetic movements): shared mechanism evidence is Acetylcholine Neurotransmitter Release Cycle; Serotonin Neurotransmitter Release Cycle (S 0.85).
Verify SNAP25-related disease (congenital myasthenic syndrome 18): shared mechanism evidence is Acetylcholine Neurotransmitter Release Cycle; Serotonin Neurotransmitter Release Cycle (S 0.75).
Verify cluster asset Natural History Study in Pediatric Patients with STXBP1 Encephalopathy with Epilepsy and its mapped disease links.
Verify cluster asset STXBP1 and SYNGAP1 Related Disorders Natural History Study and its mapped disease links.

Natural History Study in Pediatric Patients with STXBP1 Encephalopathy with Epilepsy is mapped to STX1B-related disease (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 9); it covers 55% of the target disease phenotype information (5 of 8 terms; IC 16.98/30.76).
Verify exact foundation link: STXBP1 Foundation.

Verify Rikke S Møller with STX1B-related disease (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 9): matching ORCID 0000000296641448; overlapping affiliation tokens [danish, epilepsy, filadelfia] at 'Danish Epilepsy Center Filadelfia' and 'Danish Epilepsy Centre Filadelfia'; shared co-author 'Almuth Caliebe' on PMID:26865513 and PMID:25362483.

Verify Ingo Helbig with STX1B-related disease (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 9): matching ORCID 0000000184860558; CT.gov official affiliation match "Children's Hospital of Philadelphia" / "Children's Hospital of Philadelphia"; overlapping affiliation tokens [albrechts, christian] at 'Christian Albrechts University of Kiel and University Medical Center Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH)' and 'Christian Albrechts University'; shared co-author 'Almuth Caliebe' on PMID:26865513 and PMID:25362483.

Verify Ingrid E Scheffer with CACNA1A-related disease (migraine, familial hemiplegic, 1): matching ORCID 0000000223112174; overlapping affiliation tokens [children, florey, murdoch] at "Florey Institute and Murdoch Children's Research Institute" and "The Florey Institute and Murdoch Children's Research Institute"; shared co-author 'Amy L Schneider' on PMID:36750385 and PMID:39096015.

Verify Natural History Study in Pediatric Patients with STXBP1 Encephalopathy with Epilepsy coverage (5/8) and confirm Rikke S Møller using matching ORCID 0000000296641448; overlapping affiliation tokens [danish, epilepsy, filadelfia] at 'Danish Epilepsy Center Filadelfia' and 'Danish Epilepsy Centre Filadelfia'; shared co-author 'Almuth Caliebe' on PMID:26865513 and PMID:25362483.
